renders._yaml:
- component: card
  id: qc_check_count
  title: QC checks run
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of QC checks QSEE ran, with the number of samples beside it, and the bars rank the verdicts PASS, WARN and FAIL. It answers whether the run clears its quality thresholds.
    How to read: a bar of FAIL or WARN checks is the list to open in the table. An overall sample status is FAIL if any check fails, WARN if any warns and PASS otherwise.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/master/qsee/README.md
  column: sample
  aggregation: count
  aggregations:
  - nunique
  secondary_layout: top_n
  breakdown_col: qc_status
  top_n_count: 3
  caption: checks, by verdict
  headline: true

- component: figure
  id: qc_status_bar
  title: Verdicts by source tool
  description: |-
    Each bar counts the QC checks of one source tool (BAM metrics, purity, deleted genes, contamination, TINC and so on), split by verdict. It answers which part of the pipeline raises the QC problems.
    How to read: a tool whose bar is all PASS needs no action. A tool with WARN or FAIL checks points to the stage to investigate, then the table names the feature.
    Lines and annotations: the colours are QSEE's PASS, WARN and FAIL verdicts, each set by comparing the value with the feature's default threshold, which a threshold overrides file can change.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/master/qsee/README.md
  visu_type: bar
  dict_kwargs:
    x: source_tool
    color: qc_status
    labels:
      source_tool: Source tool
      qc_status: Verdict

- component: interactive
  id: qc_status_filter
  title: Verdict
  description: |-
    Pick one or more verdicts, PASS, WARN or FAIL, to filter every tile of the dashboard to those checks.
    How to read: select FAIL and WARN to list only the checks that need attention.
  interactive_type: MultiSelect
  column_name: qc_status

- component: table
  id: qc_status_table
  title: QC verdicts per feature
  description: |-
    Each row is a QC check for one sample: the source tool, the feature, its value, the PASS, WARN or FAIL verdict and the condition that fails it. It answers which features fail and by how much, and lets a row selection filter the dashboard.
    How to read: filter the verdict to FAIL or WARN, then compare the value with the failing condition to see how far it is from the threshold.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/master/qsee/README.md
  row_selection_enabled: true
  row_selection_column: check_id
